summary: Empire Petroleum Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Roth Capital Partners, LLC to conduct an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $30 million of common stock at prevailing market prices. The Agent will receive a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. This is an ordinary shelf takedown facility, not a change-of-control event or special situation. No premium, shareholder vote, or strategic catalyst is involved. Watch for any subsequent sales announcements, but this filing alone is routine financing.
